info.description: This course provides an in-depth exploration of Production and Operations Management (POM), emphasizing its strategic role in manufacturing and service sectors. Building on demand forecasting and aggregate/S&OP planning already covered in the prerequisite course (Demand and Supply Planning Management, 709004), this course focuses on operations strategy, project management, product/service design, quality management and statistical process control, process strategy and capacity management, facility layout, job design, supply chain coordination, inventory management, MRP/ERP, short-term scheduling, lean operations, and maintenance and reliability. Through lectures, quantitative problem-solving workshops, case studies, and group projects, students develop the ability to formulate operations strategy, design and evaluate quality/process/capacity solutions, evaluate design and layout alternatives, integrate planning-and-control decisions, and design lean and sustainability-oriented operational improvements. By the end of the course, learners will be equipped to contribute to organizational competitiveness and operational excellence in a global environment.
